value.main_text_excerpt:
We want to make the world a better place by making films with a strong international impact
– FILMS –
DESERT CASTLE
3 min.Selected visuals with graphics and animation.
50 min. 2008. About the Snøhetta architects struggle to get the world’s biggest architectural project in the Arabic Emirates. Co-produced with USA. Germany. Holland. NRK.
THE DAMNED, THE POSSESSED AND THE BELOVED
8. min. 2023. From the memorial of the Witch burning process in the 16th century, at Steilnest in Vardø. Installation at the Architectural school and the National Museum Oslo.
SIX MOMENTS
10 min. 2014. Installation at the Architectural Museum in Oslo. Visualization of Norwegian architecture.
MAP OF LATIN AMERICAN DREAMS
Pilot 2.20 min
90 min. 2021 documentary on life and dreams in Argentina over the past 30 years. Co-production with Argentina and Mexico.
THE SECRET LANGUAGE
50 min. 2015. About the almost lost language, Kven.
– IN DEVELOPMENT –
A DOLL’S HOUSE
Fiction 90min. And 4. Ep. tv series of ca. 26min.
Language: Norwegian.
Production stage: Post prod.
Co-producer: Visjoner Theatre
Premiere August 2025.
Looking for co-pro, sales, and distribution.
Close and personal on classical Ibsen. Nora’s famous break up with her husband Torvald, that sets the standard for women’s liberation in 1879 and up to present time, with a global impact.
THE CAMERA NEVER CRIES
Documentary 90min.
Language: Sudanese.
Production stage: Post prod.
Premiere November 2025
Looking for sales and distribution.
On the revolution and genocide in Sudan. The two filmmakers Elsadig Mohamed Ahmed Abdelgayand and Abuzar Osman Suliman Adam was in the middle of the revolution with their cameras. When they realize that they accidentally filmed each other during the bloody morning of the massacre of Khartoum in June 2019. They join forces to make a film together. When they work the story, a new military coup occurred to take them back in the front lines of a new revolution.
WILL TO PEACE
Documentary 4. Ep. tv series of ca. 26min.
Language Norwegian. English. German and more.
Production stage: In development<
No premiere date set.
Looking for co-pro, sales, and distribution.
Karoline Wiken is a peace and environmental activist and poet asking the questions:
hy is not war part of the environmental accounting?
What will happened with world economy if there was world peace?
Can Peace be profitable?
We fallow her work, life, and ideology.
MY DAYS WITH BERGMAN
Fiction 90min. And 4. Ep. tv series of ca. 30min.
Language: Norwegian/Swedish.
Production stage: In development
No premiere date set.
Co-producer: Gøtafilm Sweden.
Looking for co-pro, sales, and distribution.
Anita Hagløf was Ingmar Bergman’s housekeeper for 8 years at the end of his life. This is her story of living in the shadow of the great master and being a support in the darkest moments. A story of power and powerlessness

pages.title: Lightsource Film Productions AS

pages.main_text_excerpt:
Lightsource Film Productions AS
Was formed in 2006 by Finn McAlinden and Arne Dahr, with the aim to make the world a better place by making films with a strong international impact. We focus on projects we find engaging and rewarding to us, but at the same time – film that can communicate to a wide audience. Ideas are easy, turning them into projects and finished films are the real challenge. We specialize in initiating the right projects early, and develop them into international films for TV, Net, and the big screen.
Do you need to communicate something in a beautiful and meaningful way?
Give us a call.
Producer/ Director: Finn McAlinden
Educated in Great Britain. Since 1995 he has worked in the film and tv industry and has built up and runs the film dept. Kristiania Professional College, Oslo, Norway. Directed and produced a wide range of award-winning films in different genres.
Producer/ Director: Arne Dahr
Educated in Denmark. Since 1993 he has worked in the film industry, in a wide range of different award-winning productions from documentaries, shorts to feature film, always aiming for an international audience. Arne was managing director of Cinema Sentrum Scene and is also an experienced film teacher, and the Norwegian film school for 4 years.
